set_fields.concise_ready_route_answer: Scan the package and then scan the recipient's FAD QR code. Release it only after FORGE validates the QR code; that validation is the proof of delivery, so an FAD-only stop does not use signature or PPOD. If there is no valid QR code, choose No Valid QR and follow FORGE's D39 non-delivery result. If validation data is unavailable, do not deliver—return the package to the station.
set_fields.more_info_answer: For mixed stops, non-FAD packages still require their ordinary signature or PPOD steps. FAD packages cannot be transferred to HAL. An unmanifested FAD package must be identified through its 2D barcode.

reason: Add current FORGE 3.3 confirmation that a code-17 recovered package may receive the actual subsequent status other than code 16, while retaining code 18 for successful same-day redelivery.

set_fields.authoritative_rule: The FORGE workflow records recovery as a misdelivery pickup using code 17. A successfully completed same-day redelivery is recorded using code 18 at the correct-address stop. Current FORGE also permits a recovered code-17 package to receive another factually applicable status except code 16 when redelivery is not successfully completed.

required_procedure.action: Create or use the misdelivery pickup workflow for the wrong-delivery location and scan the recovered package.
Apply the code-17 misdelivery pickup disposition and close the recovery stop.
If the package can be redelivered the same day, create/use the stop for the correct address and scan the recovered package there.
For a successful same-day redelivery, complete the code-18 workflow. If it is not successfully redelivered, select only the other status that truthfully applies; FORGE excludes code 16 after code 17.
Handle each recovered package by its own actual result; do not flatten a partial redelivery into one outcome for the group.

prohibited_actions: Do not use code 16 after a package has code 17
Do not flatten a partial same-day redelivery into one result for every recovered package
Do not redeliver until the correct address is established
Do not apply a status that does not match the actual result
set_fields.concise_ready_route_answer: Record the recovered package through the misdelivery-pickup workflow with code 17. If you successfully deliver it to the correct address the same day, use code 18. If it is not successfully redelivered, use only the other status that truthfully applies—current FORGE does not allow code 16 after code 17. Handle each package separately.
set_fields.more_info_answer: The recovery and later outcome are linked but separate actions. Ready Route must know whether the package was recovered, whether the correct address is known, and what actually happened to each recovered package before selecting the final status.

reason: Add the complete current FORGE 2.2.0 Download Pickup List quick reference while retaining the older-version gate on separate Download Manifest and Refresh Manifest branches.

set_fields.authoritative_rule: The current June 2025 Download Pickup List guide says the option appears on the Stop List menu only when no pickup list was received during login, uses the logged-in work area, and requires cellular connectivity. Selecting it requests the list and OK returns to the Stop List with downloaded pickups. A Ground list with no stops says to try again later; an Express work area with no list says no valid pickup listing was found. The separate Download Manifest and Refresh Manifest branches remain documented only in the April 2025 FORGE 2.8.0 guide and require current-version confirmation.
set_fields.concise_ready_route_answer: For a missing pickup list, the current guide says you need cellular service and the Download Pickup List option appears only when no list was received during login. Open it from the Stop List menu, run the request, and select OK to return to the downloaded list. If Ground says the list contains no stops, try again later. The separate Download Manifest and Refresh Manifest steps are still version-sensitive; if those screens differ or expected work is missing, contact management/station rather than assuming there is no work.
set_fields.more_info_answer: The current guide also says unlisted pickups completed before initiating Download Pickup List can be reconciled at End of Day. The older guide says Refresh Manifest adds/removes van-scanned packages and expires after the first stop closes, but that separate branch still needs current-version confirmation.
